_comment: Terms that are DELIBERATELY kept in English in every shipped catalogue (product/protocol names). i18n_review_chunked.py waives a reviewer issue that complains such a term is untranslated; it never waives anything else. Add a term only with a reason.

terms.Passkey: WebAuthn product term; the UI and the operator docs use it verbatim in every language
